utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, do you have any confirmed repair requests or helper names yet? I’m still waiting on the room from Pia, so I need the list of actual jobs and who can cover them.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—confirmed names, yes. I’ve only got a few maybes so far, so I’ll write down the actual repair jobs and helpers and get you that list before 3:30.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—please separate confirmed jobs from maybes, and include what tools each job needs. If I don’t have it by 3:30, I’m not putting it on the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Hana, I’m still mostly hearing things second-hand, but porch lights and loose handrails seem to be the biggest needs so far. Oren may bring some supplies around 3:30, and Gus can help early Saturday with a hand truck.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Nell — that matches some of what I’ve heard, but I’m going to hold off on sharing it until Pia confirms the room and date. Can you keep noting any other priority repairs people mention?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Absolutely, I’ll keep a little list and stick to confirmed details before passing anything around. If I hear other repeat needs besides porch lights, handrails, or carrying help, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Kira, I’m with you—before anyone announces or contributes, I’ll ask the office for written confirmation of the repair list, location, treasurer handling, and who’s authorized to collect money.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Pia—once you have that in writing, please send it to me before I tell anyone to bring tools or contribute anything.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Absolutely, Kira—I won’t ask anyone to bring tools or contribute until I’ve got the written confirmation, and I’ll send it to you first.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Dane — I’m tracking the repair drive logistics, but I’m still waiting on Faye to confirm the exact drop-off table and tool station locations before I point anyone there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Opal — I’ll hold off directing folks until Faye confirms, and I’ll keep the screws, hinges, and work lamp ready to bring once you have the spot.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Dane — I’ve noted screws, hinges, and the work lamp with you, and I’ll send you the confirmed spot as soon as Faye gives it in writing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Eli — I’m lining things up around school pickup, and the repair drive is set for Sunday at the community center around 3:30. Are you able to help then?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Faye — Sunday at the community center around 3:30 works for me, but I’ll keep it tentative until Hana and the room details are confirmed in writing. Once that’s settled, I can help keep the repair list organized.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Eli — I’ll wait for Hana’s written confirmation on the room details and then send it along. Once that’s set, having you organize the repair list would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam, we’re lining up small appliances, bikes, clothing, and simple electronics for the repair drive, but we’re still waiting on Hana to confirm the date and location. I can help spread the word once that’s set.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Jules — I’ll hold off on sharing details until Hana confirms, and I’m already planning to bring my drill and hammer when we get the go-ahead.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks Sam — a drill and hammer will be really useful. I’ll let you know as soon as Hana locks in the date and place.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Noah — I’ll keep the repair drive invite tentative and won’t share date, place, money, or parts details until Hana or Mara confirms.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn — that’s exactly right. I’m still a little scattered, but the repair categories are small appliances, bikes, clothing, and simple electronics for now.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it, Noah — I’ll keep those categories noted separately and won’t spread the invite beyond a tentative heads-up until Hana or Mara confirms the logistics.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Leo, I’m still slammed, but I’m spreading the word and nudging handy folks toward the repair drive—if I can swing by for a bit, I will.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Bo—that’s plenty. If you can, point them to meet at my porch around 3:30 and bring basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—Leo’s porch at 3:30, basic tools; I’ll pass that along when I nudge people.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo, I’ve got the batteries and screws set aside, and I’ll bring them to the community center on Sunday for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thank you, Rosa — that’s perfect, and I’ll mark batteries and screws down as covered for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Cleo — thanks for keeping the list so tidy. I’ll check in with Faye about the table setup and make sure my supplies land in the right spot Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Mara, I’m checking the repair drive details before I pass them around—Oren says he’ll start around 3:30 with duct tape, maybe a flashlight, and screws if he finds them; does that sound right to you?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, that sounds right for Oren—please pass along 3:30 with duct tape, a flashlight if he has one, and any screws he can find. Noah’s sorting tools, Ira and Mina are on tables around 9, and Bo and Rey are greeting folks.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, thanks Mara—I’ll pass along 3:30 for Oren with tape, flashlight if he has one, and screws, plus Noah on tools, Ira and Mina on tables around 9, and Bo and Rey greeting folks.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Uli, I’m helping get the word out for the repair drive—please remind folks to bring any tools or broken items, and I’ll pass along the time and place once Hana confirms them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik — I’ll remind folks, but I’ll keep the time and place quiet until Hana confirms. I’m also checking what repairs people need most so Rosa and Gus can plan.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, thanks Uli — I’ll tell people to bring tools or broken items and mention that you’re checking repair needs, but I’ll wait on Hana before sharing any time or place.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Ira, I’m signed up to come early and greet folks, but I’m still learning the rest—what part are you handling for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m planning to help with table setup around 9, and I’m just catching up on who’s handling repairs and supplies. If you hear anything while greeting folks, send it my way and I’ll pass it to the right organizer.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira — I’ll keep my ears open while greeting and send any repair or supply updates your way. I’ve heard Cleo is tracking supplies and Noah is sorting donated tools, so I’ll point folks that direction too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Ira! I’m passing along that the repair drive should kick off around 3:30, with Oren bringing duct tape, maybe a flashlight, and screws if he can find them—have you heard anything else I should add?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Tess — I’ve heard Noah’s sorting donated tools, Bo and Rey are greeting folks, and Mara asked me to help with table setup around 9. Cleo’s tracking supplies too, so I’ll pass along Oren’s duct tape and maybe flashlight and screws.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, thanks Ira—I’ll spread that Noah’s on donated tools, Bo and Rey are greeting, you’re helping Mara with tables around 9, and Cleo’s tracking supplies alongside Oren’s tape and maybe flashlight and screws.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m still checking what folks actually need fixed before I promise anything, Opal, but it sounds like small hardware and basic household repairs are coming up most.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Uli — I’ll note small hardware and basic household repairs as likely needs, but not final. I’m still waiting on Faye’s confirmed locations before I point anyone to a table or station.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds right, Opal—please keep it tentative until Faye confirms, and I’ll let Gus and Dane know once I’ve verified what supplies are actually needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Eli, glad I caught you—the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and I’m focusing first on safety fixes like porch lights and handrails.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rosa—that’s clear and helpful. I’ll mark Sunday at the community center as the plan, and I’ll start listing porch lights and handrails first unless Tess or Hana say otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Eli—thank you. If you hear from Tess or Hana, just fold their notes into that safety-first list and send me the updated count by tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still mostly going off what others have told me, Mara, but porch lights and loose handrails sound like the first priorities. Gus may be able to help early Saturday with a hand truck, and Oren might bring some small supplies around 3:30.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Nell — I’ll note porch lights and loose handrails as the first priorities, with Gus possibly early Saturday for the hand truck and Oren around 3:30 with small supplies.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That matches what I’ve heard, Mara; I’ll let you know if Ira, Rosa, or Tess pass along anything firmer before setup.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Dane, I’m still slammed, but I’m nudging handy folks your way—if anyone bites, I’ll send them straight to you.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Bo — that helps a lot. If anyone asks, we especially need folks with basic tool kits and anyone comfortable fixing small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—tool kits and small-appliance fixers, I’ll keep it short and send anyone like that straight to you.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—I’m planning to start around 3:30, after school pickup. I’ll bring duct tape, a flashlight, and spare screws if I can find where I put them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s helpful, Oren — I’ll jot you down for around 3:30 with duct tape, a flashlight, and maybe spare screws, but I’m still waiting on Hana to confirm the exact date and place before I spread the invite wider.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Quinn—please nudge me once Hana confirms the date and place, or I’ll probably wander over on the wrong afternoon with a flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Gus, I’m tracking supplies for the repair drive—could you bring any duct tape, spare screws, batteries, or a flashlight if you have them?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Cleo — I can bring duct tape, a flashlight, and whatever spare screws I’ve got. I’ll check my batteries too and let you know if I find a useful pack.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Gus — duct tape, a flashlight, and spare screws would be a big help. Just let me know about the batteries when you’ve checked.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Rey, I’m bringing my drill and hammer and helping with electronics sorting—do you need me on anything else for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Sam—that helps. I’ve heard Mara is sorting roles and Cleo is tracking supplies, so I’ll check with them before adding you to anything else.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Rey—please let me know what Mara or Cleo need, and I’ll be ready to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Leo — I’m coordinating around school pickup, and the repair drive is set for Sunday at the community center around 3:30. Are you able to help then?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, I can help Sunday at the community center around 3:30. Please confirm the drop-off table and tool station locations so I can place volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Leo — I’ll confirm the drop-off table and tool station spots as soon as I hear back, and I really appreciate you helping place volunteers around 3:30.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hi Hana — I’ve been telling folks to bring small appliances, bikes, clothing, simple electronics, and any tools they can, but I’m holding off on sharing the date and place until you confirm them.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Vik — that repair list matches what I’ve been gathering, but please keep holding the date and place until I confirm with Pia. Also, can you mention porch lights and loose handrails as current priority repairs?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it, Hana — I’ll keep the date and place quiet until you confirm with Pia, and I’ll start mentioning porch lights and loose handrails as priority repairs.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Kira, I’d still wait for Hana or Mara before sharing the full repair list or saying anything official about money or parts—I don’t want to steer people wrong.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That’s exactly why I’m holding off, Noah. If Hana or Mara sends the confirmed list and who’s handling money or parts, forward it to me in writing and then I’ll share it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yes, I’ll forward you whatever Hana or Mara confirms in writing before you share anything—sorry, I’m trying not to muddy it up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Jules, thanks for committing to the basic kit and 9 o’clock setup—do you have any repair names yet, or should Gus keep your list blank for now?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No confirmed names yet, so have Gus keep my list blank for now—but I’ll send any names over as soon as they’re firm.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, I’ll have Gus keep it blank for now—please send him any confirmed names the minute you have them.
